reviews.comment: Class was easy, it was the professor that made it difficult. She would lecture, but they were all over the place and inconsistent. Her grading criteria and feedback is unclear. Expects participation and will call on you if you do not speak. She seems inconvenienced when asking for support. Just try your best to avoid her classes!

Professor Howells class is very disorganized,  expects you to take notes but the lectures are all over the place, and your grade depends on the exams. She won't tell you prompts so you have to study pretty much every possible theme, book, and other literary devices to pass. Treats this class like we don't have other coursework. Worst class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely the worst professor I've ever had in 4 years at A&M, was very passive aggressive all the time, constantly acted inconvenienced to have to do her job, and feedback on writing was useless. The final for the class consisted of an essay and short excerpts that you had to know title and author for, so hope you memorized every text in the class
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I'm an English major and this was the only English prof who gave me a B in all 4 years of my time at A&M. I have received As in much harder classes, she just didn't like me. Her feedback in incredibly unhelpful and vague. Her directions are almost always unclear so the class often showed up confused or having done different things for homework.

Ok at first I thought I really enjoyed this class but towards the end of the semester i think I'm changing my thoughts. The only heavy weighing grades in this class are 2 midterms which are essays written in class, group presentation with vague instructions, and a final that you have to ID texts from just a couple of sentences plus an essay.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not bad, just not a very engaging professor. Lots of small discussion groups in class, lots of boring lectures. Attendance not mandatory, she recorded every meeting. Grading criteria was convoluted and she seemed to bounce around when grading; her comments aren't very helpful and always sound demeaning, even when she's complimenting you. Okay prof
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Probably the worst experience I've had with an English professor throughout my time here. You'll be better off not selecting this class. Had a very vague grading scale and was very subjective according to what she wanted.  Material is easy, but prof is not.
